title: ExportDecision v1
description: A domain-neutral, revisable permission-axis record: whether one hash-pinned case package may be exported under one export mode. The permission axis is orthogonal to the fact axis (export-receipt/v1) and to the case's single-axis review state; decisions never write back into the case package (ADR-0004, decisions 1-3).

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact case package version.

case.description: The single case package this decision governs. One-directional and hash-pinned; the lineage anchor for decision supersede chains.

outcome.description: Binary permission outcome. Conditional permission is expressed as allow plus constraints, never as a third enum value.

export_mode.description: The export mode under consideration (architecture vocabulary). On a deny decision this is the refused request mode: audit information, not a grant.

model.description: Optional model identifier when a model drove the decision.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision, bound to a version identifier; a human review is labeled through tool.

rationale.description: Why this outcome was decided; never blank.

constraints.description: Intent-level constraints (for example redaction intent). v1 records intent only: no redaction executor exists in this phase. May be an explicit empty array, but the field itself is mandatory.

supersedes.description: Optional decision_id of the prior decision this one revises. ID-only lineage reference within the same case anchor; earlier decisions are never edited in place.
